mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% and FEDFUNDS above 3.0% signal aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts below 1800 thousand units signals an impending economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1800 and the regime is late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 115.0 (index) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 115.0.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained CPIAUCSL reading above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary policy tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 1800 thousand units and consumer spending (RSAFS) below 340,000 million dollars signal a weakening demand environment that reduces corporate revenue expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST < 1800 and RSAFS < 340000.
